statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-60876: BusyBox wget through 1.37.0 accepts raw CR, LF, other control bytes and spaces in the request target of a URL, so a crafted URL can split the HTTP request line and inject request headers. The fix makes wget reject any URL containing a byte at or below space with the error "Unencoded control character found in the URL!" (https://lists.busybox.net/pipermail/busybox/2025-November/091818.html). Inspected every busybox-source package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository for x86_64 and aarch64: busybox (1.37.0-r30, 1.37.0_git20260210-r31, 1.37.0_git20260212-r31 and 1.37.0_git20260817-r32, plus 1.37.0_git20260210-r30 on aarch64), busybox-static (the same versions plus 1.37.0_git20260209-r31), busybox-extras, busybox-suid, busybox-binsh, ssl_client and the doc, openrc and ifupdown packages. wget is an applet of /bin/busybox and /bin/busybox.static only; busybox-extras provides network daemons and clients without wget, and ssl_client is the TLS helper wget runs, with no URL handling of its own. The busybox and busybox.static binaries of 1.37.0-r30 do not contain that check. Every busybox and busybox.static binary of every later version (1.37.0_git20260209-r31 to 1.37.0_git20260817-r32) contains it. The two other versions published, 1.37.0_git20260204-r30 and 1.37.0_p20260204-r30, contain only ssl_client on aarch64 and no wget code. Under apk version ordering, 1.37.0_git20260204-r30 is the first version above 1.37.0-r30, so this range places 1.37.0-r30 on the affected side and every later build on the fixed side.
